title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Hargel Island (Crystal Caves)
description:
The crystal cave background seen in Hargel Island (Ice Area), from the Super Famicom version of Popful Mail. A great fit for icy caves, in general. The palette exanimation was hard to rip, so sorry if it is not accurate to the source material, did my best to match the speed of the animation.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
